results.title: FigsFlow TMS & Client Portal QA
results.tagline: Quality assurance for Sterling Wells' flagship practice management SaaS
results.description: Comprehensive manual and API testing for FigsFlow (figsflow.com), a SaaS practice management and onboarding ecosystem built by Sterling Wells Services. Assured quality across the Task Management System (TMS), client onboarding flows, AML compliance checks, regulatory engagement letters, and client portal integrations.
highlights: Rigorous testing of FigsFlow Task Management System (TMS) tracking, scheduling, and timesheets
Client Portal validation: AML/KYC identity checks, proposal generator, and digital e-signing
Defect tracking and sprint bug management in Microsoft Azure Boards with full reproduction logs
API endpoint validation with Postman for billing, workflows, and system notifications
Regression testing across bi-weekly sprint releases ensuring zero critical bugs in production

results.title: SauceDemo Automation Framework
results.tagline: Automated e-commerce checkout & login with Selenium & Pytest
results.description: Modular automation testing framework built in Python using Selenium WebDriver, Pytest, and Page Object Model (POM) to automate user checkout workflows on SauceDemo with clean reporting.
highlights: Page Object Model (POM) architecture for modular, maintainable code
Automated login, catalog browsing, cart operations, and checkout validation
Parametrized test cases with clean Pytest assertions and fixtures
Open-source repository available on GitHub

results.title: Chatboq SaaS QA Suite
results.tagline: Multi-module validation & automation for AI chatbot platform
results.description: Rigorous QA testing for Chatboq.com SaaS platform covering chat inbox, ticketing, visitor tracking, billing tiers, and AI bot response handling. Created automated Playwright and Selenium suites.
highlights: Playwright and Selenium automation test scripts for critical user journeys
Full test case coverage for inbox, ticketing, billing, and AI conversational modules
Defect management in ClickUp with reproduction steps, severity, and screenshots
Frontend element inspection and UI/UX layout validation

results.title: Blockchain Based Voting System
results.tagline: Decentralized voting platform built on Ethereum
results.description: Final year project developing a transparent, tamper-proof voting system on the Ethereum blockchain to eliminate fraud, protect ballot privacy, and ensure verifiable audit trails.
highlights: Smart contracts deployed on Ethereum blockchain
Successfully conducted pilot testing with 150 participants
Zero ballot tampering and verified vote tallying
Positive feedback for transparency, usability, and data security

results.title: Bus Ticket Booking System
results.tagline: Java reservation system with real-time seat tracking
results.description: Class project in Java implementing core OOP principles, file handling, real-time seat availability tracking, dynamic fare calculation, and admin schedule management.
highlights: Real-time seat tracking and passenger ticket booking management
Dynamic fare calculation, reservation, and cancellation workflows
Admin portal to configure routes, bus schedules, and pricing
Edge-case verification and data integrity testing
